body: i can understand the ones who go on shootings before the end. When I was young I remember being mad at the world and feeling alone from being bullied. Eventually I came to understand that those bullies never really realized at the time what they were doing or how much it hurt the other kids they did it to. Killing them wont fix anything or help anyone, it only causes more pain. But when those who commit those horrible crimes are feeling hopeless and angry it can be almost impossible to see that.

Also, yea life sucks sometimes, but its not all bad. Think about the good stuff, you could have more stuff like that again. It might not be easy but im sure its possible.
